title: A Digital Twin to Improve the Sustainability of Neighbourhood Scenario Planning
reason: Implemented neighbourhood scenario prototype and substantive Monte Carlo/MCDA uncertainty, but endpoint is operational energy and ecological planning; no material-stock, recovery or embodied-impact interface.
domain_relevance: Adjacent neighbourhood energy/ecology planning, not direct material chain
dt_status: Implemented static-data browser scenario prototype; no automatic physical synchronisation established
uncertainty_mechanism: 800 bounded random-sampling runs for selected economic/ecological inputs; explanatory regression; 500 MCDA weight perturbations; data-join missingness retained
evidence_locator: PDF pp.2-4 sections2.3-2.4 and3.1; pp.5-7 sections3.5,4
limitations: Sampling selected coefficients does not propagate all geospatial errors. Static annual/offline data, generic ecological proxies and single thermal scene; internal consistency/ranking robustness rather than field predictive validation. Paper scenarios named S1-S3 are unrelated to our stage labels.
review_scope: All extracted main-body text pp.1-7 read; references p.8 inspected; no independent figure-data reconstruction
identity_verified: Title/authors/DOI on PDF p.1 match source
